source_audit.whfast_safe_mode_behavior: safe_mode=1 synchronizes at the end of every step and reconstructs Jacobi coordinates from inertial particles at the next step.
source_audit.megno_behavior: The N_var block requests synchronized positions for MEGNO, but the existing safe_mode=1 path is already synchronized at that point.
source_audit.additional_force_behavior: WHFast transforms to inertial coordinates before acceleration evaluation. The compiled callback reads positions, adds accelerations only, sets force_is_velocity_dependent=0, and neither requests nor causes synchronization.
source_audit.minimal_mode_validity: REBOUND 4.6.0 officially supports safe_mode=0 with keep_unsynchronized=1. integrate() synchronizes physical arrays at each scheduled endpoint while preserving the unsynchronized internal p_jh state.
source_audit.did_modify_particles_equivalent: This version has no did_modify_particles API. Manual particle edits require ri_whfast.recalculate_coordinates_this_timestep=1; the controls perform no particle edits between outputs.

existing_lane_effective_settings.variation_initialization: sim.init_megno(seed=12345) creates one first-order variation block; sim.lyapunov() initializes its LCN access.
existing_lane_effective_settings.scientific_output: sim.integrate(target, exact_finish_time=1), then read synchronized physical and variation particle arrays.
existing_lane_effective_settings.simulationarchive: sim.save_to_file(path, interval=100000 Julian years); archive heartbeat serializes state and does not itself request synchronization.
existing_lane_effective_settings.restart: load final eligible SimulationArchive snapshot, validate fingerprint/schema/MEGNO, trim later CSV rows, reattach compiled callback, and continue at the next scientific target.

state_and_energy_definitions.coordinate_frame: Solar-system barycentric ICRF Cartesian physical state.
state_and_energy_definitions.units: SI for masses, Cartesian states, energies, angular momentum, and center of mass; Julian years are exactly 31557600 s.
state_and_energy_definitions.physical_scaling: For matched states use [dx/AU,dy/AU,dz/AU,dvx/(AU/JulianYear),dvy/(AU/JulianYear),dvz/(AU/JulianYear)] and RMS over stated samples, bodies, and components.
state_and_energy_definitions.kinetic: K=sum_i 0.5*m_i*(vx_i^2+vy_i^2+vz_i^2), including the Sun and all ten real particles.
state_and_energy_definitions.normalized_energy: e(t)=(E_corrected(t)-E_corrected(0))/abs(E_corrected(0)); use 1 J only if the initial corrected energy is zero.
state_and_energy_definitions.energy_recomputation: At every epoch use telemetry-order float64, explicit-term math.fsum, and Decimal precision 60 constructed directly from state CSV strings.
state_and_energy_definitions.angular_momentum: L=sum_i m_i*(r_i cross v_i), measured about the stored barycentric origin.
state_and_energy_definitions.center_of_mass: Mass-weighted barycentric position and velocity over all ten real particles.
state_and_energy_definitions.matched_epoch_rule: Match exact sample_index and exact target time; no interpolation.

long_history_analysis.source: Step 3c Decimal corrected-energy histories for the existing 0.5-day and 0.25-day lanes.
long_history_analysis.ols: Unweighted OLS after centering time and e. The descriptive 95% CI uses the usual Student-t standard error with N-2 degrees of freedom; R^2=1-SSE/SST.
long_history_analysis.blocks: Ten closed 100 kyr intervals [100000*b,100000*(b+1)] for b=0..9; adjacent blocks share their exact boundary sample.
long_history_analysis.prefix_rule: Use every exact 100-year sample from t=0 through the stated endpoint, inclusive.
long_history_analysis.detrending: Subtract the full-history centered OLS line; report residual RMS and peak-to-peak.
long_history_analysis.periodogram: scipy.signal.periodogram with 0.01/year sampling, linear detrending, boxcar window, density scaling; report five strongest nonzero frequencies.
long_history_analysis.allan: For averaging lengths m=[1,3,10,30,100,300,1000] samples, compute sqrt(0.5*mean((avg[i+m]-avg[i])^2)) from overlapping m-sample averages.
long_history_analysis.increments: Use consecutive 100-year e differences; report mean, sample standard deviation, RMS, median, MAD, p01, p99, skew, excess kurtosis, positive fraction, and lag-1 correlation.
long_history_analysis.elapsed_scaling: OLS slope of log(prefix range or absolute endpoint) against log(prefix duration) over all five prefixes.
long_history_analysis.range_expansion: A range is expanding when its 1000-kyr prefix range exceeds its 100-kyr range by more than 4x and the fitted range exponent exceeds 0.25.

ias15_benchmark.projection: For each epsilon multiply observed 100-year runtime by 100; sum both projections.

reproduction.control_blocks: Ten closed 10 kyr intervals over 100 kyr; adjacent blocks share boundaries.

material_reduction.physical_accuracy_rule: Against the converged epsilon=1e-13 IAS15 state over 10 kyr, the proposed control global scaled RMS and each inner-planet RMS must be <=1.25 times the comparator plus 1e-14.

reversibility.scaled_state_rms: Same AU and AU/JulianYear component scaling as physical-state convergence.
reversibility.timestep_scaling: log(error_0.25/error_0.5)/log(0.25/0.5) for each positive return metric.
reversibility.interpretation_gate: Use only tests with exact integer step counts, explicit synchronized comparisons, exact callback totals, and return time within 1e-6 s.

runtime_and_disk_estimates.basis: Existing 1 Myr full tangent runtimes were 2393.812259 s at 0.5 day and 4921.371133 s at 0.25 day; scale linearly by duration and conservatively retain tangent cost.

artifact_requirements.scientific_lane_integrity: Exact expected target times/counts; unique sample indices; finite states; schema/fingerprint match; readable archive; zero nonfinite callback results; no duplicate rows.
artifact_requirements.whfast_callback_rule: Exactly one compiled callback invocation per full WHFast step; expected totals are preregistered per lane.
artifact_requirements.ias15_callback_rule: Adaptive callback totals are determined by accepted/rejected IAS15 force evaluations and are recorded, finite, positive, and reproducible only under the identical runtime build.
artifact_requirements.timeseries_policy: Raw lanes, recomputed timeseries, archives, logs, binaries, and caches remain ignored under output_root.
artifact_requirements.committed_artifacts: Manifest, focused source/tests, compact JSON/Markdown reports, and five deterministic PNG figures only.

classification_rules.SYNCHRONIZATION_RECALCULATION_BIAS: Physical-only current_sync reproduces the existing full-lane drift at both timesteps; min_sync materially reduces slope/max/RMS/p99 by >=4x at both timesteps without worsening IAS15-referenced physical accuracy; tolerance-converged IAS15 does not reproduce the drift.
classification_rules.VARIATION_MEGNO_COUPLING: Physical-only current_sync materially reduces full-lane drift at both timesteps; current_sync and min_sync reproduce one another; tolerance-converged IAS15 does not reproduce the full drift.
classification_rules.SYSTEMATIC_WHFAST_STEP_BIAS: The systematic per-step signature passes for full and physical-only histories; synchronization modes do not materially reduce it; tolerance-converged IAS15 does not reproduce it.
classification_rules.RANDOM_WALK_ROUNDOFF: Elapsed-time evidence fits the preregistered square-root range, the systematic signature fails, controls retain compatible stochastic behavior, and IAS15 does not reproduce drift.
classification_rules.BOUNDED_ENERGY_OSCILLATION: Both long histories pass every bounded-history rule; a periodic residual alone is insufficient.
classification_rules.CORRECTED_INVARIANT_OR_FORCE_PROBLEM: IAS15 is tolerance-converged and both tolerance lanes pass the preregistered scientifically significant same-sign drift rule.
classification_rules.MIXED_OR_INCONCLUSIVE: Integrity passes but evidence satisfies no single complete causal rule or supports multiple unresolved mechanisms.
classification_rules.BLOCKED: A preregistered audit, benchmark, integrity, telemetry reproduction, IAS15 convergence, or reversibility-validity gate fails and prevents defensible classification.

step3_status_rules.STEP3_NUMERICAL_FLOOR_CHARACTERIZED: Independent-integrator, synchronization-control, reversibility, and long-history evidence support one coherent numerical-floor mechanism without requiring a configuration change or physics change.
step3_status_rules.STEP3_INTEGRATOR_CONFIGURATION_CHANGE_RE: A synchronization or variation/MEGNO configuration mechanism is causally isolated and materially reduced by an exact supported configuration change.
step3_status_rules.STEP3_FORCE_INVARIANT_PROBLEM: The CORRECTED_INVARIANT_OR_FORCE_PROBLEM rule passes; no force or invariant change is made here.
step3_status_rules.STEP3_DIAGNOSIS_INCONCLUSIVE: Primary mechanism is MIXED_OR_INCONCLUSIVE or evidence is otherwise insufficient without an integrity failure.

next_action_policy.numerical_floor_characterized: Provide but do not execute a bounded Step 3e prompt for one 0.125-day 1 Myr lane with a separately preregistered evidence-based roundoff envelope.
next_action_policy.configuration_change_required: Provide but do not execute the smallest revalidation plan for only the isolated configuration change.
next_action_policy.force_problem: Stop and report; do not modify validated physics in Step 3d.
next_action_policy.inconclusive: State the smallest missing bounded evidence; do not request a 0.125-day lane automatically.
